title: 40-Minute Recording Budget (when enforced)
description: The generated TR doc must be recordable within constraints.recording.max_minutes (40). Recording is paced at constraints.recording.minutes_per_slide (1.5) minutes PER SLIDE whatever is on the slide, so the budget is spent by the SLIDE COUNT: 26 slides = 39 min. The amount of TEXT does not consume recording time — it consumes PAGES, which is the separate document_length_pages set. The older word-count estimate is still reported as narration_minutes for comparison but does NOT gate.
criterion: estimated_minutes <= 40 when enforce_time is on, i.e. slides <= 26 at 1.5 min each. A doc far under budget is only a concern if it is under because sub-concepts were dropped — check coverage, not minutes. Trimming a slide's text must never be recommended to save time.

rubric.5: <= 26 slides / <= 39 min — inside the budget, with the slide allowance used to cover the syllabus.
rubric.3: 27-28 slides (40-42 min) — marginally over, or so few slides that coverage looks thin.
rubric.1: > 28 slides (> 42 min) when the limit is on, or short because sub-concepts were cut.

cases.rationale: 24 slides x 1.5 = 36 min, inside the 40-minute budget with the full syllabus covered.
At the ceiling: 39 min. The higher word-count narration figure is reported for comparison only and must not fail the doc.
31 slides x 1.5 = 46.5 min — over the ceiling. The fix is fewer slides, not less text.

input.note: 5 key takeaways, 6 slides — sub-concepts dropped to look short

cases.rationale: Well inside the budget but only because coverage was cut, which is the worst trade.

automated_check: graders/time_grader.estimate(): estimated_minutes = slide_count x minutes_per_slide under constraints.recording.pacing='per_slide'. Gated in pipeline.evaluate; time_grader.max_slides_in_budget() is the slide ceiling the recording budget implies (26).
